note: Lessons from Blueprint Reader blind runs. Sealed answer keys are never included.

rules.rule: General notes and specification text about hydrants are never a physical hydrant instance. A project-wide plural rule (e.g. 'ALL NEW FIRE HYDRANTS ...', 'HYDRANTS ... AS PER ... STANDARDS') or text sitting under a WATERMAIN NOTES / GENERAL NOTES / NOTES: / SPECIFICATIONS heading is logged as a general_note_or_spec mention, not counted.
positive_examples: ALL NEW FIRE HYDRANTS TO BE AS PER CITY OF COQUITLAM STANDARDS
negative_examples: INSTALL NEW FIRE HYDRANT FROM EXISTING 200Ø WATERMAIN

why.error: false positive: page 2 WATERMAIN NOTES rule counted as a new hydrant

evidence_sources: Blind Run 02 grading report, Coquitlam Cedar Drive Phase 2, Contract 81832 (PDF sha256 76531477...)

status.fix_validation: real-drawing: general note correctly excluded in Blind Run 03 (Cumberland, v3, GPT-6 graded); Cedar Drive pages themselves not re-run

limits: Notes gating is geometric (x -40..+600 pt, y 0..600 pt below heading): a real site callout directly under a NOTES heading would be suppressed (kept as a mention).

rules.rule: On a page with TYPICAL SECTION(S) / TYPICAL CROSS SECTION / TYPICAL DETAIL(S) / TYP. SECTION, a hydrant label with no site-action verb (INSTALL, SUPPLY, REPLACE, RELOCATE, REMOVE, ABANDON, DECOMMISSION, SALVAGE, TIE, CONNECT) is an illustration, never a physical instance.
positive_examples: Hydrant label inside a TYPICAL SECTIONS illustration with no action verb (e.g. 'PR. HYDRANT')
negative_examples: INSTALL NEW FIRE HYDRANT ... (plan-sheet callout with action verb)

why.error: false positive: TYPICAL SECTIONS illustration label counted as a new hydrant

evidence_sources: Blind Run 02 grading report, Coquitlam Cedar Drive Phase 2, Contract 81832 (PDF sha256 76531477...)

status.fix_validation: synthetic-only (no typical-section hydrant case exercised on real drawings yet)

limits: Page-level: on a mixed plan + typical-section sheet, verb-less plan labels like 'PR. HYDRANT' would be suppressed.

rules.rule: A callout 'TIE IN AT/TO/INTO [EXISTING] HYDRANT' is a tie-in action, not a hydrant body. A tie-in with no hydrant word (main-only tie-in) is not a hydrant tie-in.
positive_examples: ULVERTSTON AVENUE & FIFTH STREET TIE IN AT HYDRANT
negative_examples: ULVERTSTON AVENUE & MILL STREET TIE IN

why.error: tie-in left 'unresolved'; Checker: no hydrant body drawn, detail shows cap, coupler, 2x 45° bends, profile 'TIE-IN TO EXISTING' STA 2+003.500. Page 9 claimed 2nd hydrant tie-in rejected by Checker (main tie-in near 2+259.438)

evidence_sources: Blind Run 03 grading.json + Blueprint Checker verdict, Cumberland 34277 (PDF sha256 b3c47c1a...)

status.dispute: Page 9 second hydrant tie-in: GPT-6 says yes, Checker says none; Kyle to decide
status.fix_validation: synthetic tests + NON-BLIND Cumberland diagnostic agrees with Checker; awaiting fresh blind run

limits: 'AT HYDRANT' may be a location reference rather than a hydrant connection (Checker's uncertainty).

rules.rule: A hydrant's station comes from a matching profile label with its printed STA (e.g. 'HYDRANT TEE AND VALVE CLUSTER' at STA 2+170.745) before the nearest chainage label. Fall back to nearest chainage only when no matching profile label exists.
positive_examples: HYDRANT TEE AND VALVE CLUSTER  STA 2+170.745
negative_examples: Nearest chainage tick '2+200' near the plan callout
rules.negative_examples_meaning: not used as the hydrant station when a matching profile label exists

why.error: station reported 2+200 (nearest chainage); profile prints 2+170.745, plan leaders hit main at ~2+171

evidence_sources: Blind Run 03 grading.json + Blueprint Checker verdict, Cumberland 34277 (PDF sha256 b3c47c1a...)

status.fix_validation: synthetic tests + NON-BLIND Cumberland diagnostic; side effect unchecked: p8 new hydrant now gets STA 2+009.015

limits: Geometric pairing assumes the STA label sits beside the profile label (<=20 pt).
One matching profile label per page assumed; multi-hydrant sheets without chainage stay on fallback.
